name: Irresponsibility
overview: Scripture reveals that irresponsibility, particularly in fulfilling vows and doing what is known to be right, is sinful and displeasing to God, as seen in Deuteronomy 23:21 and James 4:17. Wisdom calls for diligent attention to God's commands and a heart inclined to obedience (Proverbs 2:1), while foolishness and neglect bring harm to oneself and others (Proverbs 11:29). The Lord hates certain behaviors linked to moral failure (Proverbs 6:16), and a failure to understand and receive God's word results in spiritual blindness (John 8:43). Thus, true responsibility involves faithfully living according to God's revealed will.
